primaryTextRead.text: The sons of Ezrah: Jether, Mered, Epher, and Jalon; and Mered’s wife bore Miriam, Shammai, and Ishbah the father of Eshtemoa.

wikipediaRead.actualBodyLocator: “Ishbah” section, lines 333–337; says the name is a clan in 1 Chronicles 4:17 and explains the genealogical personification / MT–LXX difference.
